name: ABMB
recent: Alliance Bank Malaysia Berhad 近期公告几乎全部是 EPF 作为大股东在 2026 年 8 月至 11 月间的连续持股变动申报。公司于 2026 年 8 月 26 日发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度业绩。近期没有其他重大企业活动或新闻。
notable: EPF 在 2026 年 8 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。
公司于 2026 年 8 月 26 日发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度业绩。
risks: EPF 作为大股东在 2026 年 8 月至 11 月间频繁申报持股变动。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度营收为 MYR 630.241 million，环比增长 6.3%，同比增长 2.5%；净利为 MYR 248.316 million，环比增长 20.5%，同比增长 25.0%；净利率为 39.4%，高于上一季度的 34.7%。

recent_en: Alliance Bank Malaysia Berhad's recent announcements are almost entirely continuous shareholding change notifications by EPF as a substantial shareholder between August and November 2026. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 26 August 2026. There were no other major corporate activities or news recently.
notable_en: EPF filed multiple shareholding change notifications between August and November 2026.
The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 26 August 2026.
risks_en: EPF as a substantial shareholder filed frequent shareholding change notifications between August and November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 630.241 million, up 6.3% QoQ and 2.5% YoY; net income was MYR 248.316 million, up 20.5% QoQ and 25.0% YoY; net margin was 39.4%, higher than 34.7% in the previous quarter.
